text:
sam: Noticed a runtime surge and more 413s on /v1/embeddings this morning. Most failures are from mixed-dimension payloads where clients send large arrays without any shape hint. Example tenant: 120 vectors, dims 128/768/2048 in same batch, payload ~9MB.

mira: Do we have the raw header snapshot? Are SDKs involved or direct HTTP calls from customers?

sam: Snapshot snippet:
```
Content-Length: 9000000
User-Agent: example-client/1.2.3
Body: [[...128 floats...], [...768 floats...], [...2048 floats...], ...]
```
Seems like a handful of enterprise customers still use custom clients. Our JS SDK includes Embed-Shape in beta but not enabled everywhere.

jon: Telemetry shows three signals correlate: embed_payload_bytes, embed_mixed_dims_flag, and embed_ingress_parse_ms. The last spikes when runtime inspects JSON to infer dims. That CPU pressure causes backpressure and then runtime returns 413 fast.

rachel: Two paths to mitigate: 1) server-side: do a cheap prefix scan that only samples first N vectors to infer shape (low CPU), and if mixed, respond with 409 (client should split) with details. 2) client-side: publish a lightweight preflight API /v1/embeddings/shape-check that accepts metadata only and returns split instructions.

sam: I prefer preflight because it avoids adding parse logic to the hot path. Also we can cache preflight results for short TTL at the edge per (tenant, shape_signature). We should define shape_signature as dims, count, total_bytes.

mira: If we go preflight, SDKs should set header `X-Embed-Shape: 128:10,768:40,2048:70` (dim:count pairs). That keeps payload tiny. For non-SDK clients, return 400 with a helpful error pointing to the preflight doc.

jon: Metrics implications: add preflight_request_count, preflight_cache_hit, preflight_latency_ms. Also augment embed_split_count and embed_route_nodes. Console should show preflight cache hit ratio.

rachel: Rollout plan: add preflight endpoint behind feature flag `embed.preflight.enable`, enable for staging, then canary 5% tenants (beta), watch preflight cache hit > 50% and embed_ingress_parse_ms drop by 40% before widening.

sam: Quick mitigation while building preflight: runtime can accept an `X-Embed-Prefer-Split: true` header that tells ingress to immediately split by bytes into N chunks (heuristic) instead of parsing. This is useful for customers who can opt in now via proxies.

mira: Good call. We'll document the header. Also add console quick action to "Suggest split for tenant" which runs a one-off preflight simulation and posts the suggestion as a console note. Useful for SRE/CS to help customers.

metrics-bot: note: creating metric dashboards: preflight_success_rate, preflight_cache_hit_ratio, embed_ingress_parse_ms_p95, embed_413_rate. Creating alert: embed_413_rate > 0.8% over 5m for canary.

deploy-bot: trigger: feature flag `embed.preflight.enable` rollout started for group beta (5%). https://go/internal/flags/embeds/preflight

jon: One more UX thing: cost estimates. When preflight recommends splitting across 3 nodes, console should show both per-request estimated cost and total end-to-end latency. Need deterministic mapping from split_count -> node_usage for billing math. I'll draft a mapping doc: split_count 1=>1 node, 2=>2 nodes, 3+ => ceil(split_count/2) nodes for v2 runtime.

sam: I'll prototype the preflight response body like:
```
{ "split_recommended": true, "split_plan": [ {"part_bytes": 3000000},{"part_bytes":3000000},{"part_bytes":3000000}], "est_p95_ms": 520, "est_nodes": 2 }
```
Include a shape_signature back so clients can cache by it.

mira: I'll add console widgets: preflight usage over time, tenant-level preflight dependents (percent calls using preflight), and a note when SDKs are out-of-date.

jon: Action items: 1) sam open runtime PR for preflight endpoint + opt-in `X-Embed-Prefer-Split` heuristic. 2) mira add telemetry & console tiles + admin quick action. 3) sam/mira update SDK teams to add `X-Embed-Shape` header and automatic preflight call when payload > 2.5MB or mixed dims. 4) rachel draft rollout doc and canary criteria.

rachel: I'll schedule a 30m sync after the staging run to review numbers. If staging preflight_success_rate < 90% we stop.

sam: tagging @oncall and @cs to prep notices for customers who might see new 400s pointing to preflight.

mira: Thanks team. Let's meet tomorrow 9am PT.
